diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a moderate downward trend (a net fall of ~52% of its level). A moderate seasonal pattern is present. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (24 points, ~2% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.556), which favours a selective combination.
